Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
It would be helpful if the old functionality of not having to have "index.php" in the URL could be restored - which was, I presume, being done by an Apache rewrite rule or similar.

Currently, quite a few links into the site from Google link to the version of the URL without index.php and get 404s. e.g. I can find links to:

www.vekn.net/forum/6-rules-questions/16699-momentums-edge--gambit-accepted
www.vekn.net/forum/7-deck-clinic/4220-deck-mashup-3rd-ed-tzimisce-starters
www.vekn.net/forum/9-event-reports-and-twd/9614-hunger-moon-atlanta-mini-report

(And more.) All of these used to work, and all of which do work if you shove "index.php/" in between www.vekn.net/ and forum/

While search engines will eventually sort themselves out and stop linking to old links, in the meantime it looks more than a little unhelpful to anyone who happens to get one of the URLs that used to work in their search results.
